leftEvidence.title: The first ark journey stops at Uzzah’s death

points.label: Action and response
points.left: David gathers chosen men, places the ark on a new cart, celebrates, becomes angry and afraid when Uzzah dies, and leaves the ark with Obed-Edom.
points.right: David brings the ark from Obed-Edom with sacrifice and shouting, blesses and distributes food, then meets Michal’s contempt and answers about his abasement.

points.label: Evidence boundary
points.left: The source places celebration stops in death, anger, fear, and a three-month pause inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
points.right: The source places public celebration ends in household estrangement inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.

payload.posture: 2 Samuel 6:1–11 and 2 Samuel 6:12–23 are distinct approved David Scenes in the authored “Ark, House, and Kingdom” movement; holding them together exposes what continues and what changes without collapsing their sources.

rightEvidence.title: The ark enters Jerusalem with sacrifice and dancing

payload.tension: 2 Samuel 6:1–11 foregrounds celebration stops in death, anger, fear, and a three-month pause; 2 Samuel 6:12–23 foregrounds public celebration ends in household estrangement. Their sequence does not by itself explain every change between them.
payload.title: The first ark journey stops at Uzzah’s death / The ark enters Jerusalem with sacrifice and dancing
